storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the window. Nothing. Checks the calendar. Still tomorrow. Somehow one ordinary day has become the longest day ever.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Waiting ruins the fun.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Anticipation can make joyful moments even sweeter.

title: Trying to learn a very hard new concept
parentLabel: Struggling to learn a hard new topic

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is learning something new that feels much harder than expected, while other children seem to understand it more quickly.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand it and keep up.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The concept still does not make sense to Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Confusion begins turning into the fear that Kavi simply cannot learn it.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the problem again. Everyone else seems to know where to begin. Kavi's pencil stays still.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If I don't understand quickly, I'm not smart.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Understanding grows with patience and practice.

title: Moving to a new home or city
parentLabel: Moving to a new home

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is preparing to leave a familiar home and move to a new place.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to the familiar parts of home.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The move means leaving behind familiar rooms, places, routines, or people.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels excited about what is coming but sad about what is being left behind.
context: days before or during a family move
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks through the nearly empty bedroom one last time. The walls are the same, but without the furniture the room already feels different.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I'll never feel at home again.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Home grows wherever love and connection grow.

title: Moving abroad (very relevant for NRI families)
parentLabel: Moving to a new country

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that the family is moving to another country, far from the places and people Kavi knows.
storySeed.immediateWant: Hold on to home and familiar connections.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The distance means many familiar things will change.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement about a new country sits beside worry about leaving life behind.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The suitcase lies open on the floor. Kavi folds a favourite shirt inside and wonders how far away 'home' can travel.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I won't belong in a new country.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can build new friendships while keeping my roots.

title: Parents separating or getting a divorce
parentLabel: Parents separating

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that their parents will no longer live together.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what will happen and know that they will still be loved and cared for.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The family routine is changing in a way Kavi cannot control.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that a change between the parents might also change the family bond.
context: home, after learning about the separation
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Mama and Papa are speaking quietly. Kavi hears that things will be different and suddenly wants to know one thing: what will stay the same?

ontology.falseBeliefText: My family is broken and I'm not safe anymore.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Love and security can continue even when families change.

title: A parent starts a new job with different hours
parentLabel: A parent's new work schedule means less time together

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that a parent's new work schedule will change when they are home.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the familiar time they spend together.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The new work hours change the old family routine.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that less time together might mean becoming less important.
context: home after a parent changes jobs
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'I won't be home before dinner on Tuesdays,' Papa says. Kavi looks at the calendar. Tuesday suddenly looks very different.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Less time together means less love.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Love isn't measured by time but by care and connection.

title: Starting at a completely new school
parentLabel: Starting at a brand new school

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi begins at a school where the teachers, children, classrooms, and routines are all unfamiliar.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find their way around and find someone to belong with.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not yet know the people or routines.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Ordinary things—where to sit, whom to ask, where to go—suddenly feel like things Kavi could get wrong.
context: first day at a completely new school
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi stands outside the classroom door. Everyone else seems to know where to go. Kavi looks down at the timetable and takes a breath.
storySeed.note: Retained over SIT037 (dedup) as the stronger, more developed version.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Nobody will accept me.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can create new friendships by being myself.

title: Favourite teacher changes mid-year
parentLabel: Your favourite teacher is leaving

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that a favourite teacher will leave and be replaced by someone new.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the classroom the way it is.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The teacher is leaving and Kavi cannot change that.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that the new teacher will not understand them in the same way.
context: school during a mid-year teacher change
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'There will be a new teacher next week,' the teacher says. Kavi looks around the familiar classroom and suddenly notices all the things that will be different.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Good things never last.
ontology.trueBeliefText: New people can also become trusted guides.

title: Sudden cancellation of a normal routine event
parentLabel: A regular activity was suddenly cancelled

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been looking forward to a familiar weekly activity, but learns shortly before it begins that it has been cancelled.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the activity happen as planned.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The activity is no longer happening that day.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels disappointed and unsettled because something familiar has suddenly changed.
context: home, school, or a regular weekly activity
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi has already packed the bag and put on the right shoes. Then Mama says, 'The class is cancelled today.' Kavi looks down at the shoes. They suddenly feel like the wrong shoes for the day.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Everything has to happen the way I expected.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can adapt and discover new possibilities.

title: Summer ending and school starting again
parentLabel: Summer ending and school starting again

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is enjoying the final days of summer vacation and knows school starts again in a few days.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the carefree feeling of the holidays going.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The holiday is ending and the school routine is returning.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts treating the end of summer as though the fun itself is disappearing.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi squeezes the last drops of mango juice from the glass and looks at the calendar. School starts on Monday. Somehow Monday feels much too close.
storySeed.note: Retained over SIT058 (dedup) — stronger version, naturally supports transition/anticipation/resistance/preparation/discovery.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Fun is over now.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Every new season brings new adventures.

title: Noticing a new change in their body
parentLabel: Noticing a change in your body

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new physical change in their body that they did not expect.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what is happening and know that they are okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The change is unfamiliar and Kavi does not yet understand it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something happening inside Kavi's own body suddenly feels strange and unsettling.
context: at home, e.g. brushing teeth, getting dressed, bedtime
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi notices something different and pauses. It wasn't there before. Kavi looks again, wondering what is happening.
storySeed.note: Original bundle (tooth loss + growing pains + puberty) deliberately un-bundled. Needs age-routing at generation time — do not treat puberty as generic 5-12 content.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Growing and changing is scary.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Growing is a natural and wonderful part of life.

title: Friend suddenly acting different or 'cooler'
parentLabel: A friend is suddenly acting different

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices that a close friend has started talking, behaving, or dressing differently around other children.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the friendship feeling the way it used to.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control how the friend chooses to change.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wonders whether becoming different means the friend is becoming distant.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Yesterday, Kavi's friend laughed at the same silly joke. Today, the friend rolls their eyes and uses words Kavi has never heard them say before.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I have to change to keep my friends.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Real friendships accept me for who I am.

title: Game or app changes interface completely
parentLabel: A favourite app or game suddenly looks different

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi opens a favourite game or app and discovers that its layout has completely changed after an update.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find the familiar controls and start playing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The buttons, menus, and paths Kavi knows are no longer where they used to be.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Something familiar suddenly feels confusing and unfamiliar.
context: at home while using a familiar game or app
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi taps the usual button. Nothing happens. Kavi looks again. The screen seems to have rearranged itself overnight.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I don't like change, so I can't enjoy it.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can learn new ways of doing things.

title: New nanny or household helper joins family
parentLabel: A new helper joined the family

storySeed.childExperience: A new nanny or household helper begins working at home, and Kavi is unsure about having an unfamiliar person in their everyday space.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel comfortable and safe around the new person.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not know them yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be welcoming but is not ready to trust someone simply because the adults do.
context: home during the first days with the new helper
storySeed.narrativeSummary: There is a new voice in the kitchen and a new pair of shoes by the door. Kavi watches quietly, wondering where this new person fits into the family's world.

ontology.falseBeliefText: New people can't become part of my safe world.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Trust grows through kindness and shared experiences.

title: News of an upcoming surgery or treatment
parentLabel: Hearing about an upcoming medical procedure

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that they or someone close to them will need a medical procedure soon.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what will happen and feel safe.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The procedure has not happened yet, and much of it is unfamiliar.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi's imagination starts filling in the parts they do not understand.
context: home or after a conversation with a doctor
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the name of the procedure and quietly repeats the unfamiliar word. It is only a word—but Kavi's mind has already started wondering what it means.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I won't be able to handle what's coming.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can face difficult moments one brave step at a time.

title: Family having to cut back on treats or outings
parentLabel: The family is cutting back on treats for a while

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi asks for a usual treat or outing and learns that the family needs to spend less money for a while.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have the familiar treat or outing anyway.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The family has a temporary financial limit.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels the disappointment of a small 'no' without fully understanding the bigger reason behind it.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Can we get the usual Friday treat?' Kavi asks. Papa smiles apologetically. 'Not this week, beta. We're being a little careful right now.'

ontology.falseBeliefText: Happiness comes from having more.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Love, togetherness and gratitude bring lasting happiness.

title: Waiting anxiously for exam results
parentLabel: Waiting anxiously for exam results

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has finished an important exam and now has to wait several days before the result is released.
storySeed.immediateWant: Know the result now.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The result is not available yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The longer Kavi waits, the more the unknown number starts to feel like a judgement about Kavi.
context: days between an exam and results day
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the school portal again. Nothing. Three more days until results. Somehow a number that doesn't even exist yet is already taking up so much space in Kavi's head.

ontology.falseBeliefText: My marks decide my value.
ontology.trueBeliefText: My effort and character matter more than any score.

title: First time staying overnight away from home
parentLabel: Staying overnight away from home for the first time

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is staying overnight somewhere without their parents for the first time.
storySeed.immediateWant: Enjoy the adventure and feel comfortable enough to stay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Everything feels different once bedtime gets close.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Excitement slowly gives way to missing the familiar sounds and routines of home.
context: first sleepover with a trusted friend or relative
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The sleeping bag is ready. The snacks are ready. Everyone is laughing. Then the lights go out, and Kavi suddenly wishes they could hear the sound of home.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I can't feel safe away from home.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can feel safe in new places with trusted people.

title: Stopping a favourite hobby or activity
parentLabel: A favourite hobby is coming to an end

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi learns that a favourite hobby or activity is coming to an end.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep doing something Kavi loves.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The class, activity, or circumstance is genuinely ending.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels as though losing the activity means losing an important part of their happiness.
context: final class or final session of a favourite activity
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi puts the equipment away after the last class. For a whole year, this had been the best part of Tuesday. Now Tuesday is going to look different.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If one chapter ends, all the joy is gone.
ontology.trueBeliefText: New interests and opportunities will come.

title: Overheard adults talk about 'a big change coming'
parentLabel: Overheard grown-ups mention a big change coming

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi overhears adults mention an important upcoming change but does not hear what the change is.
storySeed.immediateWant: Find out what is going to happen.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The adults have not explained it yet.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Because Kavi has only part of the information, their imagination begins supplying the rest.
context: home, after overhearing a private adult conversation
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Once the big change happens...' Kavi hears before the door closes. Big change? What change? Kavi stands still, trying to guess what the adults didn't say.
storySeed.note: Kept as-is per lock: overheard partial information → child interprets it → seeks understanding. Must not drift into a generic 'change is coming' story.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Unknown changes are always bad.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can face change calmly and ask questions when I'm unsure.

title: Told a lie to a parent and feels a 'heavy' stomach
parentLabel: Told a lie and feels bad about it

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has lied to a parent about something and now has to decide whether to tell the truth.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid getting into trouble.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The lie is becoming harder to hide.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants the problem to disappear but feels increasingly uncomfortable carrying the lie.
context: home after Kavi has lied about a child-sized mistake or action
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Mama asks the question again. Kavi knows the first answer wasn't true. For a moment, Kavi considers repeating the lie—and then feels the heavy twist in their stomach.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Hiding the truth will protect me.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Honesty brings trust, even after mistakes.

title: Tempted to steal something
parentLabel: Tempted to steal something

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is with friends at a shop or another child's house, and a friend dares Kavi to slip something small into their pocket without paying or asking.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stay part of the fun and avoid disappointing the friends.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Taking it means knowingly stealing, and saying no risks looking uncool.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi is caught between wanting to belong and knowing the choice does not feel right.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Come on, nobody's looking. Just take it,' the friend whispers. Kavi's hand hovers near the small object. Nobody might see—but Kavi would know.
storySeed.note: REWRITTEN — previous draft was generic 'against a rule' without specifically depicting theft, which the title implied.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I must follow my friends to belong.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Doing what's right is more important than fitting in.

title: Watched someone get bullied and did nothing
parentLabel: Watched someone get bullied and didn't step in

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees another child being teased or treated cruelly and does not know whether or how to step in.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the situation stop or help the child.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi feels unsure, afraid, or too small to handle the situation alone.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to help but worries about becoming the next target.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi sees the child standing alone while the others laugh. Kavi looks toward the teacher, then back at the child. For a moment, Kavi stays where they are.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Speaking up won't make a difference.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Small acts of courage can protect others.

title: A mean kid got praised or rewarded
parentLabel: Someone unkind got praised instead

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees a child who has behaved unkindly receive praise, attention, or a reward.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand why the unfairness seems to have worked in the other child's favour.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control who gets praised or rewarded.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins wondering whether being kind actually matters when unkind behaviour seems to succeed.
context: school, playground, competition, or group activity
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi watches the child receive the prize. Kavi knows what happened earlier—and cannot understand how the person who caused the trouble is the one being celebrated.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Bad behaviour always wins.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can't control others, but I can choose my own values.

title: Wants to play but knows they should study
parentLabel: Wants to play instead of studying

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has homework still to finish when an exciting opportunity to play appears.
storySeed.immediateWant: Go play now.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The schoolwork needs to be completed first.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The fun waiting nearby feels much more urgent than the responsibility in front of Kavi.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The workbook is open on the table. Outside, Kavi can hear friends calling. Kavi looks from the unfinished page to the window.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I should always do what feels fun now.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Choosing responsibility today helps me tomorrow.

title: Tempted to look at friend's paper during a test
parentLabel: Tempted to look at a friend's test answers

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi gets stuck on a test question and can see a friend's answer nearby.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get the answer right.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not know the answer and would have to look at someone else's paper.
storySeed.emotionalTension: One quick glance could solve the problem, which is exactly what makes the choice difficult.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi's pencil stops over the blank answer. Just to the left is the solution. Kavi looks at the paper, then quickly looks away.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Cheating is okay if it helps me succeed.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Honest effort builds real confidence.

title: Told a 'bad' secret they feel should be shared
parentLabel: Told a secret that feels too big to keep

storySeed.childExperience: Someone tells Kavi something and asks Kavi not to tell anyone, but the secret involves a situation that feels unsafe, harmful, or too serious to keep alone.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the person's trust without doing the wrong thing.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Keeping the secret may mean staying silent when a trusted adult needs to know.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels torn between loyalty and the sense that this is not a secret a child should have to carry.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Promise you won't tell,' the friend whispers. Kavi nods automatically. Then Kavi thinks about what the secret actually means—and the promise suddenly feels much heavier.
storySeed.note: Distinct from ordinary friendship secrets (see SIT160) — this is specifically about a secret with real stakes, not casual gossip. Never encourage children to keep unsafe secrets.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Keeping every secret makes me a good friend.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Safe adults should know secrets that can protect someone.

title: Broke something by mistake and hid it
parentLabel: Broke something and hid it

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi accidentally breaks something important and hides what happened instead of telling the truth.
storySeed.immediateWant: Avoid getting into trouble.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The broken object will eventually be noticed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi gets temporary relief from hiding the mistake, but the worry grows.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The sound of the crash still seems to hang in the room. Kavi looks at the broken pieces, quickly moves them out of sight, and hopes nobody asks what happened.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Hiding mistakes makes them disappear.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Taking responsibility helps rebuild trust.

title: Realised some kids don't have food or shoes
parentLabel: Noticed another child doesn't have basic things

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices that another child does not have something basic that Kavi normally takes for granted.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what the child needs and whether Kavi can help.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not know what would actually be helpful.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Seeing the difference makes Kavi question why some children have things others do not.
context: school, neighbourhood, community setting, or an encounter with a trusted adult
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi notices the other child's worn-out shoes beside their own. For the first time, something Kavi has always taken for granted suddenly feels like a privilege.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Other people's struggles have nothing to do with me.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Kindness and generosity can make a real difference.

title: Saw a parent or teacher break a rule they enforce
parentLabel: Saw a grown-up break their own rule

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a parent or teacher doing something they have previously told Kavi not to do.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand why the rule seems different for the adult.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi may not feel comfortable questioning the adult directly.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins wondering whether rules are really about doing what is right or simply about who has the power to enforce them.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'No phones at the table,' Papa always says. Tonight, Kavi notices Papa's phone glowing beside his plate.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Rules only matter when they're convenient.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can choose integrity regardless of what others do.

title: Someone online asked for their personal password
parentLabel: Someone online asked for your password

storySeed.childExperience: While playing an online game, Kavi receives a message from an unfamiliar person asking for their password or login details.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep playing and possibly get the help or reward being offered.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Sharing the information could put Kavi's account or privacy at risk.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The request sounds friendly, but something about it makes Kavi unsure whether to trust the person.
context: online game or age-appropriate digital platform
storySeed.narrativeSummary: A message appears: 'Give me your password and I'll help you level up!' Kavi's fingers hover over the keyboard.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Everyone online can be trusted.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I protect myself by making safe choices and asking trusted adults.

title: Seeing someone litter
parentLabel: Saw someone litter

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees someone drop rubbish in a shared public place and walk away.
storySeed.immediateWant: Do something about the litter.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is unsure whether it is their place to speak up or what they should do.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels bothered by what happened but is tempted to stay silent.
context: park, playground, street, or other shared space
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The wrapper lands beside the bench. The person walks away without looking back. Kavi stares at it, then at the bin only a few steps away.

ontology.falseBeliefText: One person's actions don't matter.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Small responsible actions help care for our world.

title: Saw a stray animal being treated badly
parentLabel: Saw a stray animal being treated badly

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sees someone behaving cruelly toward a stray animal.
storySeed.immediateWant: Help the animal get to safety.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is unsure what action is safe or appropriate to take.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to help but knows that stepping into the situation alone could make things worse.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The dog backs away and looks around. Kavi wants to move closer—but stops, unsure what would actually help.

ontology.falseBeliefText: It's not my place to help.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Every living being deserves kindness and care.

title: Failed to keep a promise they made to a friend
parentLabel: Broke a promise to a friend

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi promised a friend they would do something and then failed to follow through.
storySeed.immediateWant: Repair the friendship and make things right.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The promise has already been broken and the friend is disappointed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi fears that one mistake may have damaged the friendship.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi sees the friend's face fall. 'But you promised.' Kavi did promise. And now there is no way to change what happened.
storySeed.note: Distinct protagonist position from SIT156 (friend breaks a promise to Kavi) — kept both.

ontology.falseBeliefText: One broken promise means the friendship is ruined.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Trust can be rebuilt through honesty and consistent actions.

title: Feels guilty for not including someone in play
parentLabel: Feels bad for leaving someone out of play

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi realises that another child was left out while Kavi and the others were playing.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make the other child feel included.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and Kavi is unsure how to bring the child in without disrupting it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels guilty because they noticed the exclusion but did not act sooner.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks across the playground and notices the child standing alone. A moment ago Kavi hadn't thought much about it. Now Kavi can't stop noticing.

ontology.falseBeliefText: There's only room for some people.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

title: Friend said something mean about their culture or family
parentLabel: A friend said something hurtful about your culture

storySeed.childExperience: A friend makes a hurtful comment about something important to Kavi's family or cultural background.
storySeed.immediateWant: Protect what matters to Kavi and decide how to respond.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is caught off guard and does not know whether to speak up or walk away.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The comment hurts because it touches something personal, while Kavi also worries about what will happen to the friendship.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The words sound casual when the friend says them. But Kavi feels them land heavily. For a moment, Kavi doesn't know what to say.
storySeed.note: The culture/family specificity is the point of this situation — do not genericize it (see the rejected 'A Friend Says Something Hurtful' partial-match candidate, which lost this).

ontology.falseBeliefText: I should hide who I am to fit in.
ontology.trueBeliefText: My identity deserves respect, and I can respect others too.

title: Found something and doesn't know whether to keep it
parentLabel: Found something that isn't yours

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi finds something valuable or interesting that clearly belongs to someone else.
storySeed.immediateWant: Decide what to do with it.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Keeping it would be tempting, but Kavi knows it belongs to another person.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi imagines what it would be like to keep the object while also wondering how the owner must feel.
context: school, playground, park, or public place
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi spots something near the bench and picks it up. Nobody seems to have noticed. Kavi turns it over in their hands and wonders who lost it.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If I found it, it belongs to me.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Doing the right thing matters more than getting something extra.

title: Overheard talk about politics, protests, or injustice
parentLabel: Overheard grown-ups talk about something unfair in the world

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi overhears adults talking seriously about something unfair happening in the wider world.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what happened and whether the world is safe.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The situation is complicated and the adult conversation does not provide enough context for Kavi to understand it.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi is unsettled by hearing adults angry or worried about something beyond the familiar world of home and school.
context: home, while adults discuss a news story or public event
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the word 'unfair' from the next room. Then another word Kavi doesn't understand. Kavi stays quiet, listening, trying to piece together what happened.
storySeed.note: 'Politics/protests' is a context, not the defining situation — the actual seed is a child encountering an adult-sized injustice they don't yet understand. Keep reassurance-focused, not graphic.

ontology.falseBeliefText: The world is only unfair and nothing can change.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Fairness grows through understanding, courage and responsible action.

title: Best friend makes a new best friend
parentLabel: Your best friend made a new best friend

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi's closest friend starts spending much of their time with a new friend.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the friendship feeling special.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control who else their friend chooses to spend time with.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi begins interpreting the new friendship as evidence that they are being replaced.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi used to know exactly where to find their best friend at recess. Lately, someone else is always standing there first.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If my friend likes someone else, I'll be forgotten.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Friendships can grow without replacing each other.

title: Friends don't reply to messages
parentLabel: Friends aren't replying to your messages

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi sends a message to friends and waits, but no one replies.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get a response and know that everything is okay.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi does not know why the friends have not replied.
storySeed.emotionalTension: The silence leaves space for Kavi's imagination to create explanations.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi checks the phone again. Still nothing. The message sits there on the screen, and Kavi starts wondering what the silence means.

ontology.falseBeliefText: No reply means they don't care about me.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I shouldn't assume the worst before I know the truth.

title: Accidentally left out of a game
parentLabel: Accidentally left out of a game

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi arrives while other children are already playing and realises they have not been included.
storySeed.immediateWant: Join the game.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already underway and nobody has invited Kavi in.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi is unsure whether to ask to join or walk away before anyone can reject them.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks toward the group, then slows down. Everyone is already playing. Nobody looks up.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Being left out means I don't belong.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can help create spaces where everyone belongs.

title: A secret wasn't shared with them
parentLabel: Friends made a plan without telling you

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that friends have made a plan together without telling Kavi.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand what the plan is and why Kavi wasn't included.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friends have deliberately kept the plan private.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts wondering whether being left out of one secret means being left out of the friendship itself.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi hears the friends whispering and then suddenly stop when Kavi walks over. 'It's nothing,' one friend says. Kavi knows it isn't.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If I'm not told everything, I'm not important.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Trust grows through honesty, not knowing every secret.

title: Friend copies their work or idea
parentLabel: A friend copied your idea

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi shares an idea for a drawing, project, game, or creation, and a friend uses the same idea.
storySeed.immediateWant: Have their own idea recognised as theirs.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend has already used the idea and may not realise why Kavi is upset.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels both angry about the copying and uncertain about whether speaking up will hurt the friendship.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the friend's project and stops. The idea is almost exactly the one Kavi had described earlier.

ontology.falseBeliefText: If someone copies me, I've lost what makes me special.
ontology.trueBeliefText: My ideas and creativity remain valuable.

title: A friend wins while they lose
parentLabel: Lost a game while your friend won

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi competes against a friend in a game and loses while the friend celebrates.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel okay about the result and still enjoy being with the friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend's success makes Kavi more aware of their own disappointment.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be happy for the friend but feels that the friend's victory has made Kavi feel smaller.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The friend jumps up cheering. Kavi looks at the scoreboard and tries to smile. The game is over—but Kavi's feelings aren't.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Someone else's success makes me less successful.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can celebrate others while continuing my own journey.

title: Friend breaks a promise
parentLabel: A friend broke a promise to you

storySeed.childExperience: A friend promises to do something important to Kavi and then does not do it.
storySeed.immediateWant: Understand why the friend broke the promise and decide what to do next.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend has already failed to keep their word.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels hurt and wonders whether the friendship can still be trusted.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi waits for the thing they were promised. The friend finally arrives—but without it. 'I forgot,' the friend says.
storySeed.note: Distinct protagonist position from SIT145 (Kavi breaks the promise) — kept both.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Once trust is broken, it can never be repaired.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Honest conversations and actions can rebuild trust.

title: Rumours or gossip spread about them
parentLabel: Rumours are being spread about you

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that other children are spreading a rumour about them.
storySeed.immediateWant: Stop the rumour and protect their friendships.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control what other people are saying.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels exposed and worries that people will believe something untrue.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi walks toward the group and the conversation suddenly goes quiet. Then someone looks at Kavi and whispers to another child. Kavi knows their name is part of the conversation.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I have to prove myself to everyone.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Truth and character matter more than rumours.

title: Friend apologises after hurting them
parentLabel: A friend apologised after hurting you

storySeed.childExperience: A friend who hurt Kavi's feelings comes back and apologises.
storySeed.immediateWant: Decide whether to accept the apology and what repairing the friendship should look like.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi is still hurt even though the friend is sorry.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants the friendship to feel okay again but is not ready to pretend the hurt never happened.
context: school or playground after a disagreement
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The friend stands beside Kavi quietly. 'I'm sorry.' Kavi has been waiting to hear those words—but hearing them doesn't make the hurt disappear immediately.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Holding on to hurt keeps me safe.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Forgiveness helps relationships heal and grow.

title: They hurt a friend's feelings by mistake
parentLabel: Accidentally hurt a friend's feelings

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi says or does something without meaning to that hurts a friend's feelings.
storySeed.immediateWant: Make things right and show the friend that the hurt was not intentional.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The words or action cannot be taken back.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi worries that making one mistake means being a bad friend.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The words are already out when Kavi sees the friend's expression change. Kavi hadn't meant it that way—but the hurt is real.

ontology.falseBeliefText: One mistake makes me a bad friend.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can apologise, repair and learn from my mistakes.

title: Asked to choose between two friends
parentLabel: Asked to choose between two friends

storySeed.childExperience: Two friends want Kavi to choose which one to play with, support, or sit beside.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep both friendships without hurting either friend.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friends are asking Kavi to choose between them.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels trapped because choosing one seems like rejecting the other.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'Choose,' one friend says. Kavi looks at one friend, then the other. Suddenly a simple question feels impossible.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I have to choose one person over another.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can be kind and fair to everyone.

title: Lost during a team game because of their mistake
parentLabel: Made a mistake that lost the game for the team

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi makes a mistake during a team game, and the mistake contributes to the team losing.
storySeed.immediateWant: Fix what happened and avoid letting the team down.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The game is already over and Kavi cannot undo the mistake.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi feels responsible for everyone's disappointment and starts wondering whether they deserve to be on the team.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The final whistle blows. Kavi knows exactly what happened—the missed pass, the wrong move, the moment the other team scored. Everyone is walking off the field, but Kavi is still standing there.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Everyone will blame me forever.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Mistakes are part of teamwork and learning.

title: Teammate isn't doing their part
parentLabel: A teammate isn't doing their part

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is working with teammates on a shared task or game, but one teammate repeatedly avoids doing their part.
storySeed.immediateWant: Get the team working together so the task can succeed.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot complete the other person's responsibility for them.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi becomes frustrated because doing everything alone feels unfair, but confronting the teammate could create another problem.
context: school team activity, group project, or team game
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi looks at the unfinished part of the task. Everyone else has done their piece. The missing part belongs to one teammate—and that teammate is nowhere near it.

ontology.falseBeliefText: I have to control others for things to go well.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Cooperation grows through patience and communication.

title: Friend gets a pet they always wanted
parentLabel: A friend got the pet they always wanted

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi discovers that a close friend has finally got the pet Kavi has always wished for.
storySeed.immediateWant: Share in the excitement without feeling jealous.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The pet belongs to the friend, and Kavi cannot simply have one too.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi genuinely loves the animal but finds it difficult to separate happiness for the friend from the wish that it were theirs.
context: visiting or talking with a friend after they get a new pet
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The puppy races across the room and straight into Kavi's lap. Kavi laughs—and then remembers whose puppy it is.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Life is unfair because I don't have what they have.
ontology.trueBeliefText: I can be genuinely happy for others while appreciating my own life.

title: A younger child wants to join the game
parentLabel: A younger child wants to join your game

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi and friends are playing a game when a younger child asks if they can join.
storySeed.immediateWant: Keep the game moving the way Kavi and the friends planned it.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The younger child may not know the rules or be able to play at the same level.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to protect the fun for the existing group without making the younger child feel unwanted.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The game is finally going well when a smaller voice appears beside Kavi. 'Can I play too?' Kavi looks at the others. Nobody answers.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Younger children will spoil our fun.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Everyone deserves a chance to belong.

title: Friend is nervous before a performance
parentLabel: A friend is nervous before a performance

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices that a friend is extremely nervous just before they have to perform in front of others.
storySeed.immediateWant: Help the friend feel brave enough to go on.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot perform or feel the nerves for the friend.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to help but is unsure what to say without making the friend's worry worse.
context: school performance, recital, play, or presentation
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The curtain is about to open. Kavi's friend keeps rubbing their hands together and whispering, 'I can't do this.' Kavi looks toward the stage, then back at the friend.

ontology.falseBeliefText: It's not my job to help.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Encouragement can help someone become brave.

title: Classmate is new and sitting alone
parentLabel: A new classmate is sitting alone

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices a new classmate sitting alone while the other children are already playing or talking in groups.
storySeed.immediateWant: Help the new child feel less alone.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi feels shy about approaching someone they do not know.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi wants to be kind but worries about making the first move.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: During break, everyone seems to have somewhere to be. Kavi notices the new child sitting alone with their lunch, looking around as if they are waiting for someone.

ontology.falseBeliefText: Someone else will help them.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Small acts of kindness can make someone feel welcome.

title: Friend keeps interrupting while talking
parentLabel: A friend keeps interrupting you

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi is trying to tell a friend something important, but the friend repeatedly interrupts before Kavi can finish.
storySeed.immediateWant: Be heard and finish what they are trying to say.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The friend keeps speaking over Kavi.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi becomes increasingly frustrated and starts wondering whether the friend actually cares what Kavi has to say.
context: conversation at school, home, or during play
storySeed.narrativeSummary: 'And then I—' Kavi begins. 'Wait, listen to this!' the friend says. Kavi stops. A moment later, Kavi tries again.

ontology.falseBeliefText: The loudest person should be heard.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Listening is an important way to show respect.

title: Group project where everyone has different ideas
parentLabel: Everyone in your group wants a different idea

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi and several classmates are working on a group project, but each child has a different idea about what the finished project should look like.
storySeed.immediateWant: Create something the whole group can be proud of.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The group cannot agree on which idea to follow.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Everyone believes their own idea is best, and disagreement begins turning into frustration.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi puts one idea on the table. Another child immediately shakes their head. Then someone else has a completely different idea. Soon the table is covered with plans—and nobody is listening.

ontology.falseBeliefText: My idea has to be chosen.
ontology.trueBeliefText: Great ideas grow when people work together.
